# S1 discovery interview — one record per stakeholder

## 45-minute arc
- 0–5 open: reason, permission, agenda.
- 5–10 context: team, responsibility, what good looks like.
- 10–25 latest real example: “Walk me through the last ticket that bounced.” Ask what happened next, duration, and source artifact.
- 25–35 pains/workarounds: frequency, manual lookup, failure handling.
- 35–40 data/limits: system records, access, data quality, retention and approval.
- 40–45 close: what was missed and who else to interview.
